title: Interest forecast succeeded [Beta]
description: This event occurs when an interest forecast requested with POST /v1/interest/forecast is successfully calculated with product interest engine. The event is delivered at least once, so the same forecast can be received more than once: use forecast_id to discard duplicates. The optional fields division_id and external_account_id are present only when informed in the request.

forecast_id.title: Forecast ID
forecast_id.description: Client-generated forecast UUID in the hyphenated 36-character format (8-4-4-4-12), in lowercase.

org_id.title: Organization ID
org_id.description: Organization ID, parsed from the access token of the forecast request.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Program ID of the forecast request.

division_id.title: Division ID
division_id.description: Division identifier informed in the request.

account_id.title: Pismo's account identifier
account_id.description: Account ID generated by Pismo's platform that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

external_account_id.title: Client's account identifier
external_account_id.description: External account ID informed by the client that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

interest_plan_id.title: Interest Plan ID identifier
interest_plan_id.description: Interest plan ID informed in the request.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Date the forecast starts from: the date (UTC) the forecast was calculated. Format = YYYY-MM-DD.

forecast_date.title: Forecast date
forecast_date.description: Date the forecast is calculated for, as informed in the request. Format = YYYY-MM-DD.

gross_balance_forecast.title: Gross balance forecast
gross_balance_forecast.description: Expected gross balance of the account on forecast_date: the current interest base plus gross_interest_forecast. Decimal string with 2 decimal places.

gross_interest_forecast.title: Gross interest forecast
gross_interest_forecast.description: Expected gross interest of the account on forecast_date: current_accrued_interest plus forecasted_interest. Decimal string with 2 decimal places.

current_accrued_interest.title: Current accrued interest
current_accrued_interest.description: Gross interest already accrued and not yet capitalized when the forecast was calculated. Decimal string with 2 decimal places.

forecasted_interest.title: Forecasted interest
forecasted_interest.description: Gross interest expected to accrue from start_date (inclusive) to forecast_date (exclusive). A position that matures before forecast_date stops accruing at its maturity. Zero when forecast_date is equal to start_date. Decimal string with 2 decimal places.
